title: Hack Night: Build in 6 Hours
description: Form a team of up to 3, pick a track, and ship something working by midnight. Snacks are on the club.

title: Weekend Web Dev Bootcamp
description: A full day of React from zero to a deployed project. Laptops required.

title: Golden Hour Photo Walk
description: An easy hour-long walk across campus chasing the best light of the day.

title: Lakeside Sketch & Picnic
description: Sketch, photograph, or just sit by the water with snacks. Mats provided.

title: Open Mic Night
description: Five minutes, any act: music, poetry, stand-up. Perform or just cheer from the grass.

title: Sunrise Yoga on the Lawn
description: Gentle flow for all levels, followed by tea. Bring a mat or a towel.

title: Guided Meditation Evening
description: Unwind after a long week with a calm, guided session. No experience needed.

title: Chai & Board Games Evening
description: Chess, Carrom, Uno, and a lot of chai. Come alone or bring friends.

title: Inter-Department Cricket Finals
description: CSE vs Mechanical for the department cup. Snacks stall opens at 2:30 PM.

title: Badminton Doubles League
description: Register as a pair. Round-robin matches followed by a knockout final.
